pregnancy_weeks.baby_growth: Week 1: The embryo is forming vital organs like the heart and brain.
pregnancy_weeks.mother_changes: You may experience morning sickness, fatigue, and mood swings.
pregnancy_weeks.diet_tip: Eat small, frequent meals. Folic acid is critical right now. Eat green leafy vegetables.
pregnancy_weeks.activity_tip: Do light walking for 30 minutes. Avoid heavy lifting.
pregnancy_weeks.warning_signs: Vaginal bleeding, severe abdominal pain, severe headache, blurred vision.

maternal_vaccines.title: Td Booster
maternal_vaccines.recommended_time: If received 2 Td doses in a pregnancy within the last 3 years

nutrition_cards.title: Folic Acid & Energy
nutrition_cards.tip_text: Your baby's brain is developing. You need Folic Acid.
nutrition_cards.local_food_examples: Spinach, methi, lentils, beans, fortified cereals.

nutrition_cards.title: Iron & Calcium
nutrition_cards.tip_text: Baby's bones are hardening and blood volume is increasing.
nutrition_cards.local_food_examples: Ragi, milk, yogurt, paneer, eggs, jaggery, amla.

nutrition_cards.title: Proteins & Hydration
nutrition_cards.tip_text: Rapid growth requires protein. Stay hydrated to maintain amniotic fluid.
nutrition_cards.local_food_examples: Dal, soyabean, eggs, lean meat, coconut water.

nutrition_cards.title: Extra Calories for Milk
nutrition_cards.tip_text: You need extra energy and fluids to produce breastmilk safely.
nutrition_cards.local_food_examples: Milk, oats, fennel seeds, garlic, almonds, moong dal.

nutrition_cards.title: Complementary Feeding
nutrition_cards.tip_text: Breastmilk alone is not enough anymore. Start mashed, soft foods.
nutrition_cards.local_food_examples: Mashed banana, soft khichdi (rice+dal), boiled potato, mashed papaya.

danger_signs.sign_text: Baby stops moving or moves very little
